The self-check machines now get the due date as `12/17/2026`. All 59 tests pass. I haven't committed anything.

The change is in `lib/legacy/sip2.js`. The `AH` field of the checkout reply now goes through a small `toMonthDayYear` helper, so the reply reads `121|AB<item>|AH12/17/2026|`. I updated the expectation in `test/sip2.test.js` to match.

Stored loans, the HTTP API and the email notices still use `YYYY-MM-DD`. Only the machine reply changed.

One shell command was denied because the session had no one to approve it. It was a Python script that made the same edits, and I made them with the file edit tool instead.

tool_input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='lib/legacy/sip2.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""/** Writes the reply to a checkout: the due date (AH) when the item was lent, else the reason (AF). */""","""/** Writes the reply to a checkout: the due date (AH, as MM/DD/YYYY) when the item was lent, else the reason (AF). */""")
s=s.replace("AH${result.loan.dueOn}|","AH${toMonthDayYear(result.loan.dueOn)}|")
s=s.replace("""function readFields""","""/** Turns a YYYY-MM-DD date into the MM/DD/YYYY the self-check machines print on the receipt. */
function toMonthDayYear(isoDate) {
  const [year, month, day] = isoDate.split('-');
  return `${month}/${day}/${year}`;
}

function readFields""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='test/sip2.test.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("AH2026-12-17|","AH12/17/2026|")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git diff --stat && npm test 2>&1 | tail -15

result:
The self-check machines now get the due date as `12/17/2026`. All 59 tests pass. I haven't committed anything.

The change is in `lib/legacy/sip2.js`. The `AH` field of the checkout reply now goes through a small `toMonthDayYear` helper, so the reply reads `121|AB<item>|AH12/17/2026|`. I updated the expectation in `test/sip2.test.js` to match.

Stored loans, the HTTP API and the email notices still use `YYYY-MM-DD`. Only the machine reply changed.

One shell command was denied because the session had no one to approve it. It was a Python script that made the same edits, and I made them with the file edit tool instead.
